# Rental OS — Sun Ocean Realty agent CRM

> Rental OS is the private CRM Sun Ocean Realty agents use to work rental leads
> (tenants looking for a home in South Florida). It requires a login. This file
> tells AI assistants (Muse, Grok, ChatGPT agents, etc.) how the app is laid
> out and how to do common tasks safely on an agent's behalf.

## Pages
- /login — sign in with the agent's email and password.
- /pipeline — the agent's leads. On a phone it is a list; on a computer it is a
  Kanban board (switch with the "Kanban" / "List" buttons in the top bar).
- /profile — the agent's profile: name, phone, license, MLS, showing areas,
  languages spoken, lead preference, alert preference, weekly availability.
- /deals — "My Deals" ("Deals" in the phone menu): the agent's own rental and
  sales clients, document submissions and commission requests with status, plus
  links to add a self-generated lead, submit docs, or request a commission.
- /transactions — submit transaction documents.
- /commission — request a commission payout.
- /sales — the sales workspace (switch with "Rentals" / "Sales" in the top bar).

## Language
The app can be shown in English or Spanish (EN / ES switch in the top bar and on
/profile). Button and field names in this guide are the English ones; switch to
EN before following them. Stored data (stages, notes) is always in English.

## Lead stages (in order)
1. Waiting for contact
2. Made Contact
3. Set showings
4. Showings complete
5. Completed Rentspree
6. Offer Sent
7. Offer Approved
8. HOA Approved
9. Move in / Deposit

## How to do common tasks on /pipeline (phone layout)
- Find a lead: type in the "Search leads" box (name, phone, area or MLS number),
  or press a stage button in the "Filter leads by stage" row.
- Each lead is an item in the "Leads" list, labelled "<name>, stage <stage>",
  with data-lead-id and data-stage attributes.
- Call or text: press "Call <name>" or "Text <name>" on the lead.
- Move a lead forward one stage: press "Move <name> to <next stage>".
- Open a lead: press "Open lead <name>". In the lead:
  - "Stage" select changes the stage immediately (saved right away), and
    "Move to next stage: <stage>" advances it by one.
  - Budget, Bedrooms, Bathrooms, Move-in Date and Cosigner are labelled text
    fields; Credit, Pets, Income Proof and Criminal / Eviction are button groups
    (the selected option has aria-pressed="true"). These edits are NOT saved until
    you press "Save changes" in the bar at the bottom.
  - "Agent Notes": type in the field and press "Save Note" (saved right away).
  - "Upload Document" attaches a file to the lead.
  - "Close lead" returns to the list.
- Add a lead: press "Add a new lead" in the bottom "Agent menu".

## Rules for assistants
- Only act on leads assigned to the signed-in agent; agents cannot see others' leads.
- Never delete leads or documents, and never change who a lead is assigned to.
  Those actions are for the broker.
- Confirm with the agent before moving a lead past "Offer Sent" or uploading documents.
- Do not paste tenant personal information (SSN, income documents) into other apps.

## Contact
Broker: Sun Ocean Realty — call or text 954-357-2807.

## API for AI dispatch agents
Base URL: this site. Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <AI_AGENT_API_KEY>`
(the broker gives this key to the AI agent; it is never shown in the app).

- `GET /api/agent/agents` — all agents with showing_areas, languages,
  lead_preference (showing_only | full_service | both), mls_affiliation and
  weekly availability. Use it to choose who gets a lead.
- `GET /api/agent/leads?status=unassigned|all&limit=50` — leads, newest first.
- `POST /api/agent/leads` — create a lead (or update it if the phone already exists).
  Body: `{ "name", "phone", "budget", "bedrooms", "bathrooms", "move_in", "area",
  "pets", "credit", "income", "notes_crm" (summary), ... ,
  "assign": { "agentEmail": "agent@…", "type": "full" | "showing" } }`
  `assign` is optional; when present the lead is assigned in the same call.
- `POST /api/agent/leads/{id}/assign` — body `{ "agentEmail", "type": "full" | "showing" }`.
  Lead ids are the phone number digits.

Assignment types: "full" = agent works the lead start to finish (60% commission);
"showing" = agent only shows the property ($250 per closed showing). Match the
type to the agent's lead_preference. Every assignment automatically emails and
texts the agent; the response's `notified` field says what was sent.
